Allow READ_TV_LISTINGS to read preview channels published by apps on this TV.

You can also grant it over ADB:
adb shell pm grant io.github.jain05vaibhav.previewrows android.permission.READ_TV_LISTINGS
Permission denied: grant READ_TV_LISTINGS to show preview rows.
